title: call.outcome
description: PAYLOAD of the `call.outcome` envelope. Topic: engagement.call.outcome. ★ Crown-jewel signal feed (moat (1) — 'your ads learn from your phone calls'). Emitted via the Origin Connector (§3.4) after the live AIM/agent extracts intents from a completed call. This is the ground-truth call quality that feeds lead-scoring (§9.5) and the CAPI QualifiedLead signal (§11). Intents from a cheap-LLM transcript pass: budget_mentioned/timeline/decision_authority/booking (§9.5).

call_ref.description: The call.completed call_ref this outcome enriches.

intents.description: Extracted conversation intents (§9.5 transcript-intent signals). The lead-scoring features.

qualification.description: Whether the lead qualified on the call (call_outcome=qualified => QualifiedLead signal §11.1).

booking.description: Booking captured on the call (drives booking.created + the Schedule ladder step §11.1).
